about: Default values for every rule of thumb in the app. Each setting has a source and the date it was checked. A dateChecked of null means 'to be checked'. Percentages are stored as written (20 means 20%). Dates are stored as YYYY-MM-DD and shown as 17 Nov 2026.

settings.source: TWW Yachts and IYC VAT guides
settings.note: Reduced rate ranges from 5.2% to 13% depending on eligibility. Tick 'Greek VAT eligible' on the enquiry to use this rate.

settings.label: APA (Advance Provisioning Allowance) default
settings.source: IYC
settings.note: Usually 25% to 40% of the charter fee. Covers fuel, food, drink, berthing and other running costs during the charter.

settings.label: Crew gratuity guide (low)
settings.source: YachtCharterFleet
settings.note: A guide only. Gratuity is at the client's discretion and is not part of the contract.

settings.label: Crew gratuity guide (high)
settings.source: YachtCharterFleet
settings.note: A guide only. Gratuity is at the client's discretion and is not part of the contract.

settings.label: Budget tolerance: 'up to X% over'
settings.source: Working rule (project brief)
settings.note: Yachts within budget are 'Within budget', up to this much over are 'Slightly over', anything above is 'Out'.
